triggers.label: New commits
triggers.help: has a head commit this routine hasn't seen

options.label: Also on commits a routine pushed

triggers.label: Checks fail
triggers.help: has a failed or errored check on its head commit

options.label: Wait until every check has finished

triggers.label: Checks pass
triggers.help: has every check passing, and settled, on its head commit

triggers.label: Changes requested
triggers.help: gets a new request for changes, or its review decision turns to one

triggers.label: Approved
triggers.help: is approved: the decision, or a new approval

triggers.label: Falls behind
triggers.help: is behind its base branch, with no conflict

triggers.label: Ready for review
triggers.help: isn't a draft, whether it opened ready or turned ready

triggers.label: New comments
triggers.help: gains new comments since the routine last fired, or since it first saw the item

triggers.label: Goes quiet
triggers.help: has had no activity for a number of days

triggers.label: On a schedule
triggers.help: holds the conditions at a set time

triggers.label: Only when I run it
triggers.help: is picked from an item's menu by you

words.yes: you have a clone of it
words.no: you have no clone of it
the repository doesn't allow updating branches
it isn't behind its base branch
it doesn't ask for your review

words.yes: workflow runs wait for a maintainer
words.no: no workflow run waits for a maintainer

ops.label: matches the pattern
ops.help: * matches any run of characters and ? one, ignoring case.

ops.label: matches the regex
ops.help: A Go (RE2) regular expression, ignoring case.

ops.label: has all of
ops.help: Holds every one of them; an empty list holds none, so it doesn't match.

ops.label: all match
ops.help: Every one matches one of the patterns; an empty list doesn't match, so a pull request that changes no file never has all its paths under docs/.

steps.label: Notify me
steps.help: A banner and an entry in the Notifications page, with the reason.

steps.label: Pin
steps.help: Pins it in the inbox, marked with the routine that did it.

steps.label: Snooze
steps.help: Snoozes it for a number of days, under your wake rules. What you set aside yourself stays as you left it.

steps.label: Dismiss
steps.help: Dismisses it from the inbox until it's restored. What you set aside yourself stays as you left it.

steps.label: Restore
steps.help: Brings it back from a snooze or a dismissal, yours too, to your attention when the routine's conditions hold.

steps.label: Mark the GitHub notification done
steps.help: Marks this item's GitHub notifications done, as the Notifications page's Done does. It changes only your own notifications, and one marked done can be moved back on GitHub.

steps.label: GitHub actions
steps.help: The app's own writes, as the review and issue sheets send them, each pinned to the head read right before it goes.

steps.label: Run a coding agent
steps.help: Starts the routine's agent on the item with a library prompt.

steps.label: Run one of my scripts
steps.help: Runs one of your own Repo scripts in the item's clone, in the app, as Repo scripts runs it. A script set to ask before running waits for your OK each time.

steps.label: Wait for the checks
steps.help: Follows the checks on the agent's pushed commit until every one has finished and settled.

steps.label: Merge it
steps.help: Once the checks passed, turns auto-merge back on if it was on, else merges when GitHub allows.

steps.label: Post the agent's review
steps.help: Posts what a read-only agent step wrote, as a comment or as its verdict.

steps.label: Tell me
steps.help: A notice when the routine reaches this step, with what happened.

githubActions.label: Ask Dependabot to rebase
githubActions.help: Comments @dependabot rebase, as the review sheet does, on a Dependabot pull request behind its base or in conflict. Dependabot force-pushes its branch, which can't be taken back.

githubActions.label: Update branch
githubActions.help: Merges the base branch into the pull request's branch, as the review sheet does. The merge commit stays.

githubActions.label: Comment one of my replies
githubActions.help: Posts one of your comment replies, filled in for the item, as the sheets post one. It can be deleted, but GitHub has told people by then.

githubActions.label: Add or remove labels
githubActions.help: Adds and takes off labels, as the issue sheet does. They can be put back by hand, and a label can start a repository's label-triggered workflows.

presets.label: GitHub tasks only
presets.help: Only the gh commands for small GitHub changes: re-run failed jobs, a comment, a label.

presets.label: Edit and test, no push
presets.help: Edits and runs the repository's checks; never pushes.

presets.label: Edit, test, and push to the PR's branch
presets.help: As Edit and test, plus exactly one push, to the pull request's own branch.

presets.label: The profile's own permissions
presets.help: Exactly what a click passes, within the fence's hard lines.

places.label: In the background
places.help: Headless, always in the item's worktree, held in by the fence.

places.label: In my terminal
places.help: Exactly a click's launch: the same holds, worktree, terminal, and session.

agentSettings.label: Prompt
agentSettings.help: A library prompt for the item's kind.

agentSettings.label: Where
agentSettings.help: A terminal run is exactly a click's launch, and defaults its routine to Ask first.

agentSettings.label: Agent
agentSettings.help: The launch defaults' agent, as a click.

agentSettings.label: Profile
agentSettings.help: The launch defaults' profile, as a click.

agentSettings.label: Fallbacks
agentSettings.help: Profiles to use when one is out of usage, another agent's included.

agentSettings.label: Plan mode
agentSettings.help: For terminal runs; in the background, Tools decides.

agentSettings.label: Worktree
agentSettings.help: For terminal runs; in the background, always on.

agentSettings.label: Launch settings per org or repository
agentSettings.help: Rows that override the agent, profile, model, and effort for one org or repository.

agentSettings.label: Budget per run
agentSettings.help: Dollars, for an agent that enforces one, or tokens, for any agent whose stream reports usage.

agentSettings.label: Budget per run in tokens
agentSettings.help: The budget set in tokens, starting at its default once switched to tokens.

choices.label: Edit, test, and push to the PR's branch

agentSettings.label: Extra commands to allow
agentSettings.help: Never loosens the fence's hard lines.

limits.label: Wait between tries on one item
Daily budget
limits.help: In dollars or in tokens; Settings → Autopilot's daily cap still holds beside it.

scheduleStyles.label: For each match
scheduleStyles.help: Runs its steps on each item that matches at the time, and tells you of each on its own.

scheduleStyles.label: Once, with the list
scheduleStyles.help: Runs its steps on each item that matches at the time, and tells you once, with one digest that lists them: “5 pull requests need you: 3 failing, 2 conflicting”. Notify me comes first.
